title: Midnight Sunwatch
text:
🌙 Midnight Sunwatch — October 21, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B5.4)
🔥 Latest solar flare: B7.0 (Peaked October 21, 2026 at 03:33 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 393 km/s (Moderate)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Unsettled (Kp 3.67)
🚨 NOAA Warning: Geomagnetic K-index of 4 expected

Nice and quiet out there. 💛

Several active regions are bright in today’s solar images, with a noticeable limb prominence also visible.

Image: NOAA GOES-19 SUVI — 171 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
